<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:27">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 27</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:24">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אחוי ליה ש׳ דנורא</he> he (the angel of death) showed him a rod of fire.—Pl. <cite ref="U00385"><he>שׁוֹטִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00390"><he>שׁוֹטֵי</he></cite>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) <he>דנקטין לי בשתין ש׳ וכ׳</he> they urged me (the sun) on with sixty rods of fire and said to me, go, let thy light shine.
<cite ref="Ketubot 77a:18">Keth. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>הא במילי הא בש׳</he> the one means force with words, the other, with rods.
